mcp-abap-adt/search.semantic: Run an ABAP class or program and see its output, optionally under the profiler or in the background.

description: [read-only] Runs a class or a program in one request. Required: target_type*(CLASS|PROGRAM) + class_name* for CLASS or program_name* for PROGRAM [onprem only — programs exist on premise]. Optional: profiler_id (the profiler id of a scheduled trace; given, the run goes under that trace; absent, the run is plain), background. Response: JSON { success, class_name | program_name, output }, plus profile: { profiler_id } for a run under a trace. Recordable: in batch mode a call is recorded under the next number and answers with empty content; its answer is read by number after the batch ends.

background.description: When true, the run goes on in the background on an ABAP session of its own and the call answers at once with a run_handle; read its answer later with HandlerBackgroundRunGet, and remove it with HandlerBackgroundRunDiscard. A started run cannot be stopped. No default: without it the call waits for the run to end.

profiler_id.description: The profiler id of a scheduled trace. Given, the run goes under that trace; absent, the run is plain.

name: HandlerProfileRun
